title: Atal Amrit Abhiyan – Assam Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health assurance scheme aimed at reducing financial burden for eligible residents for specified serious diseases and treatments.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on Assam residency and the current notified beneficiary/income or category requirements; verify the current enrolment criteria with Assam authorities.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Atal Amrit Abhiyan – Assam.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
